resources.string: Can\'t hide this folder on the device

A hidden .nomedia file is added to the folder. Its photos and videos stop appearing in every gallery app, this one included, and cloud backup apps may stop uploading them. Nothing is deleted or changed, and you can show the folder again from Settings → Folders.
Android only lets an app create or delete a .nomedia file in another folder with “All files access”. UltimateGallery uses it for nothing else: it never reads, changes or uploads your files.
